title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Revenue Operations Manager

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 2 days WFH) | 💰 Up to £70,000


Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everyone by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.


Your job is to own the numbers for the entire commercial engine. Not hit them, own them. You'll build the single version of the truth that runs our marketing, sales and customer success functions, and put a reliable set of numbers in front of our leadership team and board.


You will take accountability for the integrity of the full commercial funnel from top-of-funnel marketing through to churn and renewals. Right now, each function applies its own definitions and rules. You'll set one consistent set of rules and make them stick across the entire business. You'll also be responsible for forecasting, headcount planning and supporting the design of commission structures.


This is a hands-on, senior operator role. You'll own the tech stack (HubSpot sits at the centre), and you'll build the workflows, automations and permissions that keep data clean at source. You're not tidying records by hand; you're designing systems. You'll also be working with AI daily – it's not optional here. We use Claude, and you'll need to show evidence of AI already embedded in how you work.


There are no commissions or bonuses in this role and that is deliberate. The role has to stay objective

title: Associate Relationship Manager - London
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

title: Head of Design
description:
About Odin

Private markets are overdue a design transformation, and there is still no design-led company setting the standard for the category. Most products in the space look and feel like a bank statement from 2009. We’re looking for someone to help us change that.

Odin is building infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Mission

We’re looking for a senior design leader who combines exceptional visual craft with systems-level product thinking. You’ll play a central role in defining and elevating the customer experience at Odin as we prepare for a major US launch.

description:
RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in.

The Role

This is not your typical Customer Success role.

RevenueCat prices based on how much money a customer makes. That creates an unusually clear alignment of incentives: when our customers grow, we grow.

That means Customer Success at RevenueCat should be more than relationship management, implementation check-ins, and polite QBRs.

Our best CSMs understand a customer’s app, audience, business model, growth goals, internal constraints, RevenueCat usage, and decision-making dynamics well enough to help that customer make better decisions.

Sometimes that means helping them adopt the right RevenueCat feature.

Sometimes it means spotting that their paywall, pricing, lifecycle, onboarding, or retention motion deserves a closer look.

Sometimes it means bringing in a technical partner to make sure an implementation question gets answered correctly.

Sometimes it means bringing in one of our growth specialists — people with deep expertise in areas like paywall conversion, lifecycle messaging, paid user acquisition, pricing, or gaming monetization — when a customer has a specific high-impact growth problem worth digging into.

And often, it means doing the unglamorous but critical work of keeping everyon

title: Account Manager
description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 아임웹을 핵심 도구로 사용하고 있는 고객사들이 우리의 파트너입니다. Account Manager는 담당 고객사의 매출 성장과 리텐션을 직접 책임지면서, 동시에 고객사가 아임웹을 더 깊이 활용해 다음 성장을 만들어내도록 돕는 역할입니다. 고객사의 GMV가 곧 우리의 성과 지표이며, 활용 깊이를 만드는 일과 매출을 만드는 일을 한 사람이 함께 책임지기에, 단기 매출과 장기적인 신뢰 관계를 동시에 만들어갈 수 있습니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    담당 고객사 포트폴리오의 매출과 운영 현황, 활용 지표를 분석하여 성장 기회와 이탈 리스크에 대응합니다.  고객사의 비즈니스 단계와 페인포인트에 맞춰 아임웹의 기능과 데이터를 어떻게 더 잘 활용할 수 있을지 제안하고, 정기 미팅을 통해 실행을 지원합니다.  활용도와 비즈니스 확장 시점을 가장 가까이에서 포착해 추가 기능과 서비스 도입을 제안하고, 업셀링과 크로스셀링으로 연결합니다.  이전 고객사의 온보딩을 리드하여, 도입 초기에 아임웹의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 경험하고 자기 비즈니스에 자리잡을 수 있도록 돕습니다.  계약 갱신과 재계약 협상을 직접 리드하며, 장기 파트너십을 통한 리텐션을 책임집니다.  고객사의 VOC와 페인포인트를 구조화해 프로덕트, CX 팀에 전달하며, 제품과 서비스 개선의 브리지 역할을 수행합니다.  잘 성장하고 있는 고객사의 사례를 발굴해 콘텐츠와 레퍼런스로 만들고, 마케팅, 세일즈 팀과 함께 다른 고객사로 확산시킵니다. title: Working Student / Intern AI Product Associate (f/m/x)
description:
TL;DR — alago brings AI-powered project management to the construction industry. As our Product Associate, you'll help build our discovery engine: the system that turns customer pains into shipped features on autopilot. Working student, on-site in Munich.

About alago

Imagine if building a building were as easy as building software. Every moving part visible, every change traceable, every decision still carrying its reasoning six months later.

Software got there by making its own history legible — every commit, every diff. Construction never did. A €200M project runs on plan sets nobody can diff and decisions buried in email, so the same mistakes happen over and over — and the industry loses $1.6 trillion a year to it.

That's what we're fixing. Eleven people, 20+ customers, €1M+ pre-seed from leading construction-tech VCs and one of Germany's largest project developers.

Aufgaben

Product management is changing forever: continuous discovery, specs written for agents as much as engineers, customer pain to shipped feature in days. You get to learn it now, on a real product with real customers.

You'll help build our discovery engine, the workflows and AI agents that catch what customers complain about and turn it into prioritized product input, and you'll be the first person to run it. What we decide to build next comes out of what you surface.

This is a new kind of role, sitting at the intersection of product, engineering and customer success:

📋 Product Operations

  • Turn customer feedback into actionable product insights
  • Write the specs those insights become, precise enough that an engineer or an AI agent builds from them without a follow-up call

Automation & AI Specialist (m/w/d)

Low-Code / n8n · CRM-Automation · KI-Agenten

Festanstellung | Remote möglich

Du liebst es, Prozesse zu automatisieren, verschiedene Systeme miteinander zu verbinden und aus einer Idee einen funktionierenden Workflow zu bauen?

Dann könnte diese Position sehr gut zu Dir passen.

Wir entwickeln CRM-, Automatisierungs- und KI-Lösungen für Unternehmen. Dabei verbinden wir CRM, Kommunikation, Daten, APIs und moderne KI-Technologien zu automatisierten Prozessen, die unseren Kunden im Alltag tatsächlich Arbeit abnehmen.

Für den weiteren Ausbau suchen wir einen technisch versierten Automation & AI Specialist (m/w/d), der gemeinsam mit uns solche Lösungen entwickelt und umsetzt.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du kümmerst Dich insbesondere um:

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von n8n-Workflows
  • Entwicklung von Automatisierungen zwischen unserer CRM-Plattform und externen Anwendungen
  • technische Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von KI- und Voice-Agenten
  • Anbindung von APIs, Webhooks und Drittanbieter-Systemen
  • Aufbau von CRM-Workflows und automatisierten Kundenprozessen
  • Verarbeitung und Synchronisierung von Daten zwischen verschiedenen Systemen
  • technische Integration von Telefonie, E-Mail, WhatsApp, Kalendern, Formularen und weiteren Tools
  • Erstellung kleinerer JavaScript-, HTML- und CSS-Lösungen, wenn Standardfunktionen nicht ausreichen
  • Fehleranalyse, Testing und Optimierung bestehender Automationen
  • Dokumentation wichtiger Workflows und Integrationen
  • Mitentwicklung neuer Automatisierungs- und KI-Lösungen

Dabei geht es nicht darum, stumpf vorgegebene Workflows nachzubauen. Du sollst Prozesse verstehen, technisch mitdenk

title: Corporate Development & Growth Intern | Private Markets
description:
Redefining Access to Private Markets

Privatize is redefining access to Private Markets. Headquartered in Frankfurt, we aim to make top-tier Private Markets funds broadly accessible. We collaborate with renowned institutions like BlackRock, Carlyle, J.P. Morgan and Ares, enabling Private Equity, Private Debt, and Real Asset investments through an innovative Fintech infrastructure.

Aufgaben

Objective of the Role

Are you interested in a career in Private Equity, Strategy Consulting or Asset Management and looking to gain meaningful experience in the Private Markets space?

As a Corporate Development & Growth Intern, you will work closely with our leadership team to support strategic initiatives across investor engagement, financial analysis, and business development.

You will contribute to high impact projects such as the development of new product strategies, investor materials, strategic growth, and market research, while gaining exposure to the dynamics of the broader Private Markets ecosystem.

Your Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of strategic projects alongside the leadership team, working with top-tier Asset Management partners
  • Conduct comprehensive market, product, and client research to deepen our knowledge base, identify growth opportunities, and support strategic planning
  • Support the acquisition and onboarding of wealth managers, banks, and family offices through targeted outreach and structured project support
  • Design and optimize dashboards, performance reports, and CRM workflows to enhance sales efficiency and data-backed decision-making
  • Contribute to financial modelling and strategic analyses to drive sustainable revenue growth and support Privatize’s broader market expansion goals

Qualifikation

What We Are Looking For

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) - Enterprise
description:
Introduction

Auf einen Blick

  • 360° Sales mit eigener Pipeline, Fokus auf gehobenen Mittelstand & Enterprise ab 1.000+ Mitarbeitenden
  • OTE 90.000-130.000 €, Split flexibel zwischen 50:50 und 70:30 je nach Erfahrung/Präferenz, Bonus uncapped
  • Klarer Weg zum Senior AE oder in eine Lead-Rolle - wir haben das schon mehrfach gemacht
  • Kunden wie Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC und Rossmann
  • Hybrid: 2–3 Tage Onsite im Office Frankfurt, restliche Tage flexibel im Home Office
  • AI-first: Claude für alle, Freiraum für eigene Automatisierungen in deinem Bereich

About The Role And Potential Progression

__Für wen dieser Job nicht ist__Bevor du weiterliest, kurz und ehrlich:

  • Wenn du Aktivität mit Ergebnis verwechselst (viele Calls, wenig Abschluss), wirst du hier nicht glücklich.
  • Wenn du lieber ein eingespieltes Playbook 1:1 abspulst statt es mitzugestalten, ist das nicht dein Umfeld.
  • Wenn dir Politik, Status und lange Freigabeschleifen wichtig sind, bist du hier falsch - wir sind knapp 50 Leute und entscheiden schnell.

Wenn du bis hier gelesen hast und denkst "genau mein Ding" - weiter geht's.

Worum es geht

Du übernimmst deine eigene Pipeline mit Fokus auf gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise ab 1.000+ Mitarbeitenden, führst Deals eigenständig von Discovery bis Abschluss und baust Kundenbeziehungen auf, die über den ersten Vertrag hinaus tragen. Du bekommst kein fertiges Territory ohne Substanz - unsere Kunden sind Namen wie die Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC und Rossmann, und das Thema (Wissen & KI im Unternehmen) hat gerade enormen Rückenwind.

Du arbeitest eng mit Sebastian (Gründer/CEO) und dem Sales-Leadership zusammen: schnelles Feedback, direkte Wege, keine Umwege über drei Ebenen. Das Sales-Team ist mit aktuell 4 Leuten bewusst schlank - du bist keine Nummer

title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Worldwide, 80% of all employees do not work at a desk.

📈 Net Revenue Retention: You take ownership of retaining and growing your customer portfolio, with a clear focus on increasing NRR through renewals, upselling and expansion.

🚀 Upsell & Cross-Sell: You identify commercial opportunities such as Payroll Plus, additional modules, seats or services and actively drive expansions and upgrades to completion.

🔎 Renewals & Churn Prevention: You proactively manage renewals, identify churn risks early and create clear action plans to retain and develop customers.

🗺️ Account Development: You build structured account plans for your customers, understand their growth plans and identify where Ordio can support them further.

📊 Pipeline & Forecasting: You maintain your renewal and expansion pipeline in the CRM,

title: Customer Success Manager till Bonnier News

Vår techorganisation består av 350 personer, varav ca 180 är utvecklare, som utvecklar produkter och plattformar för några av Sveriges starkaste varumärken, inklusive Dagens Nyheter, Dagens Industri och Expressen. Du arbetar datadrivet med uppföljning, analys och optimering samtidigt som du identifierar möjligheter till vidareutveckling, retention och affärstillväxt. Maximera affärsvärde och tillväxt: Analysera kundernas KPI:er och resultat för att säkra hög kundnöjdhet samt identifiera möjligheter till optimering, upsell och cross-sell.  Projektleda och hantera leveranser: Arbeta operativt med egna kampanjer samt briefa och koordinera interna specialistteam inom bl a Ad Operations för att säkra hög

Je richt je niet alleen op losse producten of diensten, maar ontwerpt de volledige end-to-end klantreis. Door knelpunten te analyseren en complexe klantbehoeften te vertalen naar tastbare verbeteringen, draag je bij aan zowel hogere klanttevredenheid als het realiseren van de dienstverleningsdoelstellingen van de organisatie. Zo bouw je aan duurzame relaties met gebruikers door barrières in de dienstverlening structureel weg te nemen.  Hiervoor breng je klantreizen helder in kaart — zowel de huidige situatie (As-Is) als de gewenste toekomstige ervaring (To-Be). Via kwalitatief en kwantitatief gebruikersonderzoek, zoals interviews, enquêtes en observaties, verzamel je diepgaande inzichten in klantgedrag, behoeften en knelpunten. Deze inzichten vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen in dienstverlening en processen.  Daarnaast visualiseer je met service blueprints hoe processen achter de schermen bijdragen aan de totale klantervaring. Je treedt hierbij op als verbindende schakel tussen verschillende afdelingen, zoals Marketing, IT, Sales en Customer Service, en zorgt ervoor dat belangen, inzichten en oplossingen samenkomen. Door middel van prototypes, experimenten en pilots toets je nieuwe serviceconcepten in de praktijk en stuur je waar nodig bij. Tegelijkertijd monitor je continu relevante CX-KPI’s, zoals NPS, CSAT en Customer Effort Score, om de dienstverlening data-gedreven te optimaliseren en blijvend te verbeteren. Now we are launching Spain — and once our customers are live, there's a whole world of value they haven't unlocked yet. Your job is to help them get there. OFSI is a diverse and dynamic team of over 130 people, from a variety of backgrounds and professions.
